newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN JAN CONSUMER PRICE INDEX UP 9.4 PCT Y/Y.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN JAN CONSUMER PRICE INDEX UP 9.4 PCT Y/Y.

text.p: South Africa's all-items consumer price index rose 1.3 percent in January from December after rising 1.0 percent in December, the Central Statistical Service said.
The year-on-year rise was 9.4 percent, the same as for December 1996 and the highest since June 1995 when it stood at 10.0 percent.
A Reuters consensus poll of economists forecast a 1.1 percent month-on-month increase and a 9.2 percent year-on-year rise.
